claim_v1_original.note: SYNTHETIC — original PMA paid-up capital rule, IDR 2.5B.
claim_v1_original.correction_2026_08_26: CORRECTED per RULING Zero 2026-08-26 (Research OS B1): a claim's 'superseded' state is DERIVED AT READ from the successor edge and is NEVER written onto the predecessor -- 'il vecchio resta intatto'. This object previously carried status='superseded' with valid_to closed at the successor's boundary, which contradicted both the ruling and this bundle's own bitemporal/01 fixture (predecessor left supported / valid_to null). Both writes are removed: the status because it IS the derived state, and the closed valid_to because it was set as a consequence of the amendment rather than as an independent fact this bundle verified. A reader obtains 'superseded from 2026-05-15' from claim_v2.supersedes_claim_ref, which this fixture's own expected_behavior already requires to be independently re-derivable. RESIDUAL, deliberately not decided here: whether a predecessor's valid_to may ever be written when the amending instrument states an explicit cessation date as a fact of its own -- see 07 §B2.
